societies.history: Established in November 1985 as a non-profit association, the TOG is an affiliate of the South African Orchid Council (SAOC) which is the governing body managed by a Board of directors nominated by all the different societies in the RSA. Membership is available to all people interested in orchids.

societies.name: Cape Orchid Society
societies.meetingDay: every fourth Tuesday evening of the month
societies.venue: Athenaeum, 1 Mariendahl Lane (off Campground Road) in Newlands, Cape Town.
societies.history: Founded in 1957, the Cape Orchid Society is the oldest orchid group in South Africa and a founder member of the South African Orchid Council. The COS strives to bring together those interested in orchids in order to promote and encourage the culture and conservation of orchids, as well as to educate and provide a base for all other orchid-related activities. The COS began with monthly meetings, which still continue today, providing informative presentations, practical growing advice and an opportunity for growers to display and discuss their plants and flowers. The Society hosts a number of events throughout the year, including two shows in which growers showcase their blooms, an auction, greenhouse open days and hikes. We also provide members with a newsletter, monthly guest speakers, local judging, and much, much, more!

societies.name: Northern Gauteng Orchid Society
societies.venue: Safari Garden Centre, cnr. Lynnwood Road and Rubida Street, The Willows, Pretoria East
societies.history: The Northern Gauteng Orchid Society (NGOS), formerly the Orchid Society of Northern Transvaal (ONT) was founded in 1967 and is the fourth oldest orchid society in South Africa. Based in Pretoria, it serves the Northern Gauteng and adjacent region. The society’s emblem is Angraecum stella-africae.

societies.name: Pietermaritzberg Orchid Society
societies.history: The Pietermaritzburg Orchid Society started in May 1978. It is a long-established society that serves all the orchid enthusiasts in the greater Msunduzi District in the midlands of KwaZulu-Natal. It was established to promote, develop and foster interest in culture, propagation, conservation and the study of orchids.

societies.name: Witwatersrand Orchid Society
societies.venue: The Floreum, Botanical Gardens, Emmarentia, Randburg, 2195
societies.history: The Witwatersrand Orchid Society (WOS) is one of the oldest orchid societies in South Africa. Established in 1963 under its original name, the Transvaal Orchid Society, the Society has a long-standing history of promoting an appreciation and understanding of orchids and their cultivation.

societies.name: Gonubie Orchid Society
societies.history: Gonubie Orchid Society was formed in 1998 by Eric Dodd and became affiliated to SAOC in May 1999. The Society first met at Pioneer Nursery in Gonubie. In 2014, the Society moved their meetings to the Gonubie Hotel. The Society has always been a strong Society and is well known for it’s yearly Orchid Shows. It’s membership has been strong with an average of 30 members since it’s establishment. Since May 2026, we meet at the Beacon Bay Bowling Club.
